_key.description: Variant key, phenotype ontology term and source file accession joined by underscores.

protein_id.title: Protein ID
protein_id.description: Ensembl ID of the protein (without version number).

exon.title: Exon
exon.description: Exon of the target gene the variant lies in, written as GENE_X followed by the exon number. A non-exonic variant carries the exon of the SGE target whose genomic context includes it.

target.title: Target
target.description: SGE library the variant was assayed in. Equal to exon where a single library covers the whole exon; otherwise a part of the exon.

consequence.title: Consequence
consequence.description: Most severe consequence VEP annotates for the variant against the MANE Select transcript.

score.title: Score
score.description: SGE score: the change in variant frequency over time, as log2 fold change per day. Normalized so that the median synonymous variant scores 0, so lower scores mean reduced cell fitness.

standard_error.title: Standard Error
standard_error.description: Standard error of the score estimate.

95_ci_upper.title: 95% Confidence Interval Upper Bound
95_ci_upper.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval on score.

95_ci_lower.title: 95% Confidence Interval Lower Bound
95_ci_lower.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval on score.

amino_acid_change.title: Amino Acid Change
amino_acid_change.description: Amino acid change the variant introduces into the reference sequence, using single-letter code.

hgvs_p.title: HGVS Protein Expression
hgvs_p.description: HGVS protein-level description of the variant.

functional_consequence.title: Functional Consequence
functional_consequence.description: Functional consequence assigned to the variant from its z-score.

enum_descriptions.functionally_normal: The variant is classified as having normal function under the assay thresholds.
enum_descriptions.indeterminate: The assay does not confidently classify the variant as functionally normal or abnormal.
enum_descriptions.functionally_abnormal: The variant is classified as having abnormal function under the assay thresholds.

functional_consequence_zscore.title: Functional Consequence Z-Score
functional_consequence_zscore.description: Z-score of the variant's score against the distribution of expected neutral variant scores. Thresholds on this value assign functional_consequence.

variant_qc_flag.title: Variant QC Flag
variant_qc_flag.description: Quality-control classification assigned to the variant by the assay.

enum_descriptions.PASS: The variant passes the assay quality-control criteria.
enum_descriptions.FAIL: The variant fails the assay quality-control criteria.
enum_descriptions.LOWCOV: The variant has insufficient coverage for reliable assessment.

snvlib_lib1.title: Plasmid Library 1 Variant Count
snvlib_lib1.description: Count of the variant in the plasmid library before transfection and selection, from amplicon sequencing of the targeted region.

snvlib_lib2.title: Plasmid Library 2 Variant Count
snvlib_lib2.description: Count of the variant in the second plasmid library before transfection and selection. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both.

D05_R1_lib1.title: Day 5 Replicate 1 Library 1 Count
D05_R1_lib1.description: Count of the variant at day 5 in replicate 1.

D05_R1_lib2.title: Day 5 Replicate 1 Library 2 Count
D05_R1_lib2.description: Count of the variant at day 5 in replicate 1 of the second target. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both.

D05_R2_lib1.title: Day 5 Replicate 2 Library 1 Count
D05_R2_lib1.description: Count of the variant at day 5 in replicate 2.

D05_R2_lib2.title: Day 5 Replicate 2 Library 2 Count
D05_R2_lib2.description: Count of the variant at day 5 in replicate 2 of the second target. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both.

D05_R3_lib1.title: Day 5 Replicate 3 Library 1 Count
D05_R3_lib1.description: Count of the variant at day 5 in replicate 3. Null when only two replicates passed QC.

D05_R3_lib2.title: Day 5 Replicate 3 Library 2 Count
D05_R3_lib2.description: Count of the variant at day 5 in replicate 3 of the second target. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both. Also null when only two replicates passed QC.

D13_R1_lib1.title: Day 13 Replicate 1 Library 1 Count
D13_R1_lib1.description: Count of the variant at day 13 in replicate 1.

D13_R1_lib2.title: Day 13 Replicate 1 Library 2 Count
D13_R1_lib2.description: Count of the variant at day 13 in replicate 1 of the second target. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both.

D13_R2_lib1.title: Day 13 Replicate 2 Library 1 Count
D13_R2_lib1.description: Count of the variant at day 13 in replicate 2.

D13_R2_lib2.title: Day 13 Replicate 2 Library 2 Count
D13_R2_lib2.description: Count of the variant at day 13 in replicate 2 of the second target. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both.

D13_R3_lib1.title: Day 13 Replicate 3 Library 1 Count
D13_R3_lib1.description: Count of the variant at day 13 in replicate 3. Null when only two replicates passed QC.

D13_R3_lib2.title: Day 13 Replicate 3 Library 2 Count
D13_R3_lib2.description: Count of the variant at day 13 in replicate 3 of the second target. Null unless two targets overlap and the variant was assayed in both. Also null when only two replicates passed QC.
